review.evidence: At ICON block 118968355 on 2026-10-01, the canonical legacy bnUSD SCORE reports a zero debt ceiling and remains active at code hash 0xf4d53569a3e4ba10dd69178004a070b24723cd697b899f5683722d6ea3110d41, owned by Governance SCORE cx44250a12074799e26fdeee75648ae47e2cc84219. The issuer confirms community governance retired in November 2025. The native administrative path remains unbounded; a zero current ceiling is not an immutable mint restriction. The owner's private-key custody is not established by the SCORE ownership read or retirement disclosure.
